verse: Drive sadness far away from yourself. For sadness has killed many, and there is no usefulness in it. (Sir 30:23)
You have kept count of my wanderings; put my tears into your bottle. Are they not in your book? (Ps 56:8)
In my distress, I will call upon the Lord, and I will cry out to my God. And he will heed my voice from his temple, and my outcry will reach his ears. (2 Sam 22:7)
You shall weep no more. He will most certainly be gracious to you at the sound of your cry; when he hears it, he will answer you. (Is 30:19)
The Lord God will take away the tears from every face, and he will take away the disgrace of his people from the entire earth. For the Lord has spoken it. (Is 25:8)

Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and the God of all comfort. He consoles us in all our tribulation, so that we too may be able to console those who are in any kind of distress, through the comfort by which we also are being comforted by God. (2 Cor 1:3-4)
Amen, amen I say to you, that you shall lament and weep, but the world shall rejoice; and you shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy. (Jn 16:20)
God will wipe away every tear from their eyes. And there shall be no more death. And neither mourning, nor crying out, nor grief shall be anymore. For the former things have passed away. (Rev 21:4)
The redeemed of the Lord shall return and come to Zion with praise; everlasting joy shall be upon their heads; they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and mourning shall flee away. (Is 35:10)

The Lord will comfort Zion, and will comfort all her ruined places, and will make her desert like Eden, her desert like the garden of the Lord; joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and the voice of praise. (Is 51:3)

I saw the Lord always before me, for he is at my right hand so that I will not be moved; therefore, my heart has been glad, and my tongue rejoiced; moreover, my flesh also shall rest in hope. (Acts 2:25-26)
The virgin will rejoice with singing, the young and the old together, and I will turn their mourning into gladness, and I will console them and gladden them after their sorrow. (Jer 31:13)

O Jerusalem, take off the robe of your mourning and affliction and put on the beauty and honor of the everlasting glory which you have from God. Put on the cloak of God’s righteousness; set on your head the crown of everlasting honor. (Bar 5:1-2)
The righteous cry, and the Lord hears and delivers them from all their troubles. (Ps 34:17)

Come to me, all you who labor and are carrying heavy burdens, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me; for I am meek and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light. (Matt 11:28-30)
Why are you cast down, O my soul, and why are you disquieted within me? Hope in God; for I shall praise him again, my savior and my God. (Ps 42:11)

For the Lord will not cast off forever. But though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies; for he does not afflict willingly nor grieve anyone. (Lam 3:31-33)

Be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for behold, I will create Jerusalem to be a joy, and its people to be a delight. I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and be joyful in my people; and the sound of weeping shall no more be heard in her, nor the cry of distress. (Is 65:18-19)
They will approach with weeping. And I will lead them back with mercy. And I will lead them through the torrents of water, by an upright way, and they will not stumble in it. (Jer 31:9)

There are many who say, “Who will show us some good! Let the light of your countenance shine on us, O Lord!” You have filled my heart with more joy than when their grain and wine increased. (Ps 4:6-7)
Happy is the one whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the Lord his God. (Ps 146:5)
You have turned my mourning into dancing; you have put off my sackcloth and clothed me with gladness. (Ps 30:11)
The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are open to their cry. (Ps 34:15)
The Lord is near to them that are of a broken heart, and he will save the crushed in spirit. (Ps 34:18)
In the multitude of my sorrows in my heart, your consolations have given joy to my soul. (Ps 94:19)
My soul has slumbered because of sorrow. Strengthen me according to your word. (Ps 119:28)
Cast your burden upon the Lord, and he will sustain you; he will never allow the righteous to be moved. (Ps 55:22)
Tribulation and anguish have found me. But your commandments are my delight. (Ps 119:143)
Weeping may endure for the night, but joy comes with the morning. (Ps 30:5)

I will rejoice greatly in the Lord, and my soul will exult in my God. For he has clothed me with the vestments of salvation, and he has wrapped me in the clothing of righteousness, like a groom arrayed with a crown, and like a bride adorned with her jewels. (Is 61:10)
I shall not die, but live and declare the works of the Lord. (Ps 118:17)
I discovered your words and I consumed them. And your word became to me as the gladness and joy of my heart. (Jer 15:16)
A rejoicing heart gladdens the face. But by the grief of the soul, the spirit is cast down. (Pro 15:13)
A joyful heart makes is good medicine. A gloomy spirit dries out the bones. (Pro 17:22)
May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing; so that you may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Spirit. (Rom 15:13)
Rejoice in hope; endure in tribulation; persevere in prayer. (Rom 12:12)
They will say in that day: “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us. This is the Lord! We have endured for him. We will exult and rejoice in his salvation.” (Is 25:9)
Look around, Jerusalem, towards the east, and see the joy that comes to you from God. (Bar 4:36)
Rejoice in the Lord always. Again, I say, rejoice. (Phil 4:4)
I have hoped in your steadfast love. My heart will rejoice in your salvation. (Ps 13:5)
Rejoice always, pray unceasingly, give thanks in everything; for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus for you. (1 Thes 5:16-18)
I will exult and rejoice in your steadfast love. For you have looked upon my affliction; you have saved my soul in adversities. (Ps 31:7)

Though the fig tree will not blossom, and there will be no fruit on the vines. The labor of the olive tree will fail, and the farmland will produce no food. The sheep will be cut off from the sheepfold, and there will be no herd at the manger. Yet I will rejoice in the Lord; and I will exult in God of my salvation. (Hab 3:17-18)

I keep the Lord always in my sight. For he is at my right hand, so that I may not be moved. Because of this, my heart has been joyful, and my soul rejoices. Moreover, even my body will rest in hope. (Ps 16:8-9)
You have made known to me the ways of life; in your presence is abundant joy. At your right hand are pleasures for evermore. (Ps 16:11)
This is the day that the Lord has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it. (Ps 118:24)
The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish. (Pro 10:28)
The joy of the Lord is your strength. (Neh 8:10)
Those who sow in tears shall reap in joy. Those who go forth weeping, carrying seed to sow, shall come back with shouts of joy, bringing their sheaves with them. (Ps 126:5-6)

With joy shall you draw water out of the wells of salvation. And on that day, you will say: Praise the Lord and call upon his name; declare his deeds among the people; declare that his name is exalted. (Is 12:3-4)
